Title: TEST-IMPORT-001: Smoke-test import_issues.py against the real repo
Body:
As a maintainer, I want a single throwaway issue created by `scripts/user-stories/import_issues.py`, so that I can verify the script's GitHub auth, CSV parsing, label creation, and milestone creation paths work end-to-end against the actual `syalioune/flowatch` repository before running the full backlog import.

### Acceptance criteria
- The script reads this CSV without parse errors.
- One issue titled "TEST-IMPORT-001: Smoke-test import_issues.py against the real repo" is created.
- Labels `test`, `import-smoketest` are attached (created on the fly if missing).
- Milestone `Import Smoke Test` is attached (created if missing).
- The issue can be closed and deleted manually after verification.

### Notes
- Safe to delete once verified — this is not part of the real backlog.
- Run with `--dry-run` first to confirm CSV parsing and auth, then re-run without it for the live create.
